# Setup & Development Workflow

---

## Prerequisites

- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) v18 or higher
- npm v8 or higher
- A modern browser (Firefox, Chrome, Safari)
- Internet connection (for the initial `getdatafiles` step)

### Optional (for mobile builds)

- Xcode (iOS builds)
- Android Studio (Android builds)
- [Capacitor CLI](https://capacitorjs.com/): installed via npm

### Optional (for AI embeddings)

- [Ollama](https://ollama.ai/) with `nomic-embed-text` model

---

## First-Time Setup

```bash
# 1. Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/TheJusticeMan/touch-grass-bible.git
cd touch-grass-bible

# 2. Install all dependencies
npm install

# 3. Download and process Bible data
#    (Downloads from OpenBible.info + compiles translations)
npm run getdatafiles

# 4. Start the development server
npm run dev
# Opens at http://localhost:3000 in Firefox
```

---

## Development Workflow

### Starting the Dev Server

```bash
npm run dev
```

This runs two things in parallel:
1. `node esbuild.config.mjs` — watches `src/` for changes and rebuilds `dist/main.js`
2. `live-server ./dist --port=3000` — serves `dist/` with auto-reload on file changes

Changes to TypeScript source files are reflected almost instantly (esbuild is very fast).

### Running Just the File Server

```bash
npm run serve
```

Serves `dist/` on port 3000 without a file watcher.

---

## Code Quality

### Linting

```bash
npm run lint
```

Runs ESLint on `src/*.ts`. The project uses `typescript-eslint` with recommended rules.

**Configuration:** `eslint.config.mjs`

Key rules:
- TypeScript recommended rules
- `@typescript-eslint/no-require-imports: off` for `src/electron/` files

### Formatting

```bash
npm run format
```

Runs Prettier on:
- `src/**/*.ts`
- `*.md`

**Configuration:** Prettier defaults (2-space indent, double quotes, trailing commas).

---

## TypeScript

The project uses strict TypeScript:

```json
{
  "target": "ES2020",
  "strict": true,
  "noUnusedLocals": true,
  "noUnusedParameters": true
}
```

To type-check without building:
```bash
npx tsc --noEmit
```

## Testing

There is currently no test suite. The `npm test` script prints an error message.

```bash
npm test
# Error: no test specified
```

See [improvements/testing.md](../improvements/testing.md) for testing recommendations.

## File Structure After Setup

```
touch-grass-bible/
├── dist/                   # Built output (gitignored)
│   ├── main.js             # Bundled app
│   ├── translations.json   # Compiled Bible data
│   ├── crossrefs.json      # Cross-references
│   ├── topics.json         # Topics
│   └── (web assets)
├── src/                    # Source code
│   ├── translations.json   # Translations (compiled by getdatafiles)
│   ├── info.json           # App metadata (generated by build)
│   └── ...
└── node_modules/           # Dependencies (gitignored)
```

---

## Common Issues

### `translations.json` not found

Run `npm run getdatafiles` to download and compile the Bible data.

### `dist/` directory is empty

Run `npm run dev` or `npm run build` to generate the output files.

### Port 3000 already in use

Edit the `serve` script in `package.json` to use a different port:
```json
"serve": "live-server ./dist --port=3001 --browser=firefox"
```

### TypeScript compilation errors

Run `npx tsc --noEmit` to see all type errors before building. The build uses `esbuild` which does not type-check, so TypeScript errors won't prevent a build from succeeding.

### Data download fails

The OpenBible.info data files may occasionally be unavailable. If the download fails, previously downloaded `dist/crossrefs.json` and `dist/topics.json` can be reused. The app degrades gracefully — missing cross-references or topics just means those features show no results.
